text: 你见到了一名僵尸流亡者。
source_text: 你见到了一名僵尸流亡者。

text: Shut up and I might let you live.
source_text: Shut up and I might let you live.

text: 闭上你的嘴，说不定我会饶你一命。
source_text: 闭上你的嘴，说不定我会饶你一命。

text: Don't worry, you aren't worth it.
source_text: Don't worry, you aren't worth it.

text: 别担心，你还不值得我动手。
source_text: 别担心，你还不值得我动手。

text: You . . . You're just gonna kill me, anyway!
source_text: You . . . You're just gonna kill me, anyway!

text: 你……你就是想杀我，不管怎样！
source_text: 你……你就是想杀我，不管怎样！

text: Now, tell me what happened here.
source_text: Now, tell me what happened here.

text: 现在，告诉我这里都发生了什么。
source_text: 现在，告诉我这里都发生了什么。

text: Ah, didn't you just tell me to shut up?
source_text: Ah, didn't you just tell me to shut up?

text: 呃，你不是刚刚让我闭上嘴的吗？
source_text: 呃，你不是刚刚让我闭上嘴的吗？

text: Yes, and now I want to know what happened here.
source_text: Yes, and now I want to know what happened here.

text: 是的，但是现在我要知道这里发生了什么。
source_text: 是的，但是现在我要知道这里发生了什么。

text: The super mutants attacked. We were slaughtered. They had guns and bombs, even some steam trucks. They killed my friends. The mutants just butchered us, like you're probably gonna do to me.
source_text: The super mutants attacked. We were slaughtered. They had guns and bombs, even some steam trucks. They killed my friends. The mutants just butchered us, like you're probably gonna do to me.

text: 超级变种人进攻了，我们被杀的落花流水。他们有枪有炸弹，甚至还有蒸汽卡车。他们杀了我的朋友。变种人根本就是在屠杀我们，也许你也会这么对我。
source_text: 超级变种人进攻了，我们被杀的落花流水。他们有枪有炸弹，甚至还有蒸汽卡车。他们杀了我的朋友。变种人根本就是在屠杀我们，也许你也会这么对我。

text: The super mutants attacked. We were slaughtered. They had guns and bombs, even some steam trucks. They killed my friends. The mutants just butchered us.
source_text: The super mutants attacked. We were slaughtered. They had guns and bombs, even some steam trucks. They killed my friends. The mutants just butchered us.

text: 超级变种人进攻了。我们被杀的落花流水。他们有枪有炸弹，甚至还有蒸汽卡车。他们杀了我的朋友。变种人根本就是在屠杀我们。
source_text: 超级变种人进攻了。我们被杀的落花流水。他们有枪有炸弹，甚至还有蒸汽卡车。他们杀了我的朋友。变种人根本就是在屠杀我们。

text: I heard they was pissed that some human killed their men here.
source_text: I heard they was pissed that some human killed their men here.

text: 我听说他们因为一些人类在这儿杀了他们的人，所以气得发疯。
source_text: 我听说他们因为一些人类在这儿杀了他们的人，所以气得发疯。

text: 哦，呃，还有什么其他的吗？
source_text: 哦，呃，还有什么其他的吗？

text: Hmmm. OK. Get out of here.
source_text: Hmmm. OK. Get out of here.

text: I heard some of the sewer ghouls might have survived, but I don't like it down there.
source_text: I heard some of the sewer ghouls might have survived, but I don't like it down there.

text: 我听说一些下水道里的僵尸可能幸存了下来，但我不喜欢发生在这儿的事。
source_text: 我听说一些下水道里的僵尸可能幸存了下来，但我不喜欢发生在这儿的事。

text: I hid until most of the mutants left.
source_text: I hid until most of the mutants left.

text: 我躲起来了，直到变种人离开。
source_text: 我躲起来了，直到变种人离开。

text: Some big thing that moved on wheels but without any brahmin.
source_text: Some big thing that moved on wheels but without any brahmin.

text: 一些大家伙，用轮子移动，但是没有双头牛。
source_text: 一些大家伙，用轮子移动，但是没有双头牛。

text: 呣呣，好的。还有什么其他的么？
source_text: 呣呣，好的。还有什么其他的么？

text: Hey, then why did you ask about it?
source_text: Hey, then why did you ask about it?

text: 嘿，那为什么你问起这个？
source_text: 嘿，那为什么你问起这个？

text: That's it! Enough insolence from you!
source_text: That's it! Enough insolence from you!

text: Just wanted to know. That's all.
source_text: Just wanted to know. That's all.

text: 只是想知道而已。就这么简单。
source_text: 只是想知道而已。就这么简单。

text: You again? What do you want now?
source_text: You again? What do you want now?

text: 又是你？这次你要干什么？
source_text: 又是你？这次你要干什么？

text: Nope. Well, I did hear that more super mutants were coming. I don't know when.
source_text: Nope. Well, I did hear that more super mutants were coming. I don't know when.

text: 不。好吧，我确实听说有更多的超级变种人会来到，但不知道什么时候。
source_text: 不。好吧，我确实听说有更多的超级变种人会来到，但不知道什么时候。

text: Make it elsewhere then. I gotta keep low.
source_text: Make it elsewhere then. I gotta keep low.

text: 换个地方吧，我得小声点儿说。
source_text: 换个地方吧，我得小声点儿说。
